description: Header file declaring functions related to reftable writing and buffer management in a Git-related project, with includes for utilities and other reftable components.

methods.name: cl_reftable_set_hash
methods.description: Sets a hash value in a reftable buffer at a specific index, identified by hash ID.

methods.name: cl_reftable_strbuf_writer
methods.description: Creates a writer object for a reftable buffer, configured with specific write options.

methods.name: cl_reftable_write_to_buf
methods.description: Writes reference and log records to a reftable buffer using provided options.
